status: Specified digital contracts; not implemented or validated

unit_conventions.current: A; commanded and independently measured fields distinct

permitted: past contact voltages afterAFE/ADC with timestamps/masks
permitted external observations with physical measurement support times
calibration learned only from allowed delivered-output and sensor observations
independent modeled current/voltage/charge measurements with uncertainty

test labels or expert/learner recordings from held-out evaluation

online_permissions.diagnostic_oracle: Separate visibly tagged branch allowed only for upper-bound evaluation; never counted as operational decoder.

fields.name: v_per_count

fields.name: artifact_ledger_ids
fields.meaning: Planned and actual delivered event references; unexpected clipping remains invalid.

invariants: Sample time <= arrival time after bounded clock conversion.
Block reordering must preserve sample identity; duplicates do not count as new observations.
Fast decoder consumes undecimated4kHz observations;2kHz archive must expose3.75msdecimator delay.
Missing/invalid values remain masked; recorded prediction fields cannot be renamed observations.
contracts.violation_action: Invalidate affected data; update uncertainty and gate proposals if freshness/coverage fails.

fields.name: estimated_state

fields.name: support_interval_s
fields.meaning: Earliest/latest allowed observation times actually used.

fields.name: latest_valid_sample_s
fields.meaning: Latest valid physical observation plus declared filter convention.

fields.name: feature_representative_time_s
fields.meaning: Defined weighted time or conservative age bound; not merely window end.

fields.name: information_age_bound_s

fields.name: prediction_horizon_s
fields.meaning: Forward estimate horizon; zero for state at observation time.

fields.name: observability_status
fields.meaning: QUALIFIED,AMBIGUOUS,STALE,OUT_OF_DISTRIBUTION,INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE.

fields.name: model_and_expert_ids
fields.meaning: Frozen versions and permitted task/context applicability.

invariants: No future observation consumed at action time.
Estimate uncertainty increases across unsupported intervals; prediction never fabricates a valid sample.
Coverage gates are screening requirements, not proof of sufficient neural information.
An estimate may fail even if electrical scheduling meets25ms.
Goal timing may be future-known; achieved contact/body state may not.
contracts.violation_action: Reject new motor intervention; continue observation/logging if electrically healthy. Do not replace decoder with true task phase.

fields.name: sensor_type
fields.meaning: FOOT_CONTACT,MULTIAXIS_POSE,FORCE,EMG if separately declared.

contracts.violation_action: Missing modalities stay missing; reduce state observability or reject, rather than access true pose.

fields.name: pressure_reference
fields.meaning: Sensor/cuff/reference details; no clinical-grade assertion without qualification.

fields.name: physical_peak_or_measurement_support_s
fields.meaning: Peak timestamp if provided; otherwise bounded support interval for derived1Hz value.

fields.name: extraction_time_s
fields.meaning: After pressure acquisition/beat processing/resampling.

fields.name: arrival_time_s
fields.meaning: Packet receipt; cannot replace physical measurement time.

fields.name: sensor_uncertainty_pa
fields.meaning: Includes declared bias/noise/accuracy; clinical target still unresolved.

fields.name: quality
fields.meaning: VALID,MOTION_ARTIFACT,ARRHYTHMIA,CUFF_CALIBRATION,STALE,CLOCK_INVALID,MISSING.

invariants: 4Hz service cannot create4new pressure observations/s from1Hz extraction.
Use upper bound of support age; if sensor cannot bound it, measurement freshness is unknown and adaptation is gated.
Optional spinal biomarker may supplement only when separately qualified; missing biomarker does not invalidate a healthy external-only arm.
Clinical measurement accuracy, representativeness and actionable pressure thresholds remain unresolved.
contracts.violation_action: Block new pressure adaptation and enter declared fallback evaluation. Inhibition/hold/ramp is not inherently a clinically safe choice.

contracts.name: Learner response calibration and expert transfer

fields.name: expert_representation_id
fields.meaning: Learned from declared expert observations and task reference labels; frozen before held-out evaluation.

fields.name: learner_map_id
fields.meaning: Estimated from bounded calibration inputs, measured delivery and observed effects.

fields.name: response_delay_interval_s
fields.meaning: Learned interval, not true simulator parameter.

fields.name: response_map_uncertainty
fields.meaning: Rank/sign/context/range validity; unresolved or adverse directions explicit.

fields.name: calibration_validity_context
fields.meaning: Posture,task,route,geometry,session and operatingrange.

fields.name: sensory_interference_model_id
fields.meaning: Separate from artifact masking and recruitment cross-coupling.

gates: Fail transfer if representation is out of task/context support or cross-person alignment is unidentifiable.
Fail intervention for unreachable corrections, uncertain sign, absent response or out-of-range recruitment.
Delay-prediction uncertainty counts against25ms event target; calibrating only mean delay is insufficient.
Expert information must beat equally resourced learner-only adaptation if that benefit is claimed; expert external-trajectory-only comparator separates neural content.

motor_onset_delay_s.provenance: Chosen artificial stress ranges, not published human delay; zero/absent effect separate.

synthetic_response_stress_envelope.provenance: All physiology dynamic ranges are artificial sensitivity envelopes (0..60mmHg gain, -20..0mmHg adverse direction). They are not fitted to the cited study and cannot authorize dosing.

contracts.violation_action: Abstain or use equally declared baseline policy; preserve failure as result. No true response coefficients supplied to controller.

fields.name: application_id
fields.meaning: MOTOR_PRACTICE or SBP_SUPPORT; mutually exclusive active application initially.

fields.name: goal
fields.meaning: Motor event/coordination objective or externalSBP target defined by protocol.

fields.name: estimated_response_interval
fields.meaning: Prediction from calibrated model with uncertainty.

fields.name: electrical_profile_id
fields.meaning: Versioned current/phase/frequency/route mapping; normalizedu is not a dose.

fields.name: desired_first_phase_time_s
fields.meaning: Core timestamp; not a blind immediate GPIO write.

fields.name: latest_start_deadline_s

fields.name: plan_expiry_s
fields.meaning: No indefinite replay.

fields.name: authorized_session_lease_id
fields.meaning: Authenticated finite authorization, not bypass of local health gates.

motor.status: Illustrative digital reference, not human prescription.

pressure.status: Published timing/amplitude range motivates envelope;nominal3mA and biphasic phase/gap interpretation are SCCI_RH choices, not proof of equivalent physiological action.

invariants: A signed desired task correction is not signed current polarity.
No physical current request without calibrated route/electrical mapping.
Target outside feasible pressor-only response region is reported unreachable; reducing stimulus is not independent antihypertensive actuation.
Response,energy/thermal caps and electrode/monitor limits can remove assumed authority.
Known paced goal admitted20ms before event does not provide future true movement.
contracts.violation_action: Reject and log exact failed predicate; no silent scaling presented as original commanded response.

contracts.name: Locally admitted output plan

fields.name: source_ids
fields.meaning: Two selected independently monitored current sources;four-source expansion unsupported.

fields.name: contact_and_return_route
fields.meaning: No unintended shared/grounded return; full route ownership.

fields.name: phase_edges_s
fields.meaning: Common-clock scheduled starts/ends with actual timing allocation.

fields.name: signed_command_current_a
fields.meaning: Commanded current distinct from measured current.

fields.name: planned_phase_charge_c
fields.meaning: Command integral; not measured delivered charge.

fields.name: delivery_monitor_contract_id
fields.meaning: Required current/voltage/charge/compliance monitor and independent overrun protection.

fields.name: energy_thermal_authority_id
fields.meaning: Admission cap may prohibit sustained stress pattern.

fields.name: artifact_ledger_id
fields.meaning: Planned affected channels and mask/recovery qualification.

fields.name: expiry_s
fields.meaning: No execution after deadline/session expiry.

gates: No more than2 concurrent sources and approved independent return routes.
Planned same-frame drivers align;staggered pulses admitted only in explicitly budgeted patterns.
Per-profile minimum periods apply even for event-anchored rephasing: 25ms at40Hz motor and8.333ms at120Hz pressure; configured rate ceiling150Hz per profile.

Physical source availability is checked separately: biphasic duration plus250us zero-current reconfiguration/admission. Pressure source0 time-shares three profiles at360events/s with2ms minimum cyclic spacing; a150Hz per-source ceiling is not assumed.
Concurrent source routes own disjoint contacts and dedicated returns; recording recovery does not qualify electrode/return polarization or reuse.
Current/charge/compliance/reserve/thermal gates come from electrical budget, not task policy.
Clock/monitor health and observedstate validity hold at admission and execution.
Conflicting motor/pressor applications cannot both reserve sources;no last-writer wins.
contracts.violation_action: Reject/cancel unstarted plans and preserve log. No automatic make-up burst for a missed timer.

fields.name: delivery_quality

Missing monitor data produces unknown delivery rather than zero.
Body/recruitment model uses measured modeled delivery or its uncertainty interval, not perfect commanded pulse.
Fault-caused phase interruption preserves residual-charge uncertainty;never automatic opposite correction from command memory.

fields.name: planned_event_intervals_s
fields.meaning: Used for pregating; compare actual delivered times.

Coaligned2drivers create1global interval only if delivered edges actually coincide within qualified uncertainty.
Traveling3profiles0/2/4ms create3events/frame.
5ms guessed recovery is not proof recovery completed.
Prediction over gaps retains uncertainty;artifact removal cannot reconstruct absent information without a qualified model.

contracts.name: Application lease and fallback

fields.name: authenticated_mode_authorization
fields.meaning: Session, application and configuration identities, replay counter and permitted outputs.

fields.name: authorization_expiry_s
fields.meaning: Reference maximum:0.25s motor or3s pressure; renewed only by an authenticated valid message.

fields.name: fallback_id
fields.meaning: Function-specific choice and duration validated within the model; null means unresolved.

fields.name: last_trustworthy_observation_s
fields.meaning: Physical measurement time with uncertainty, not a link heartbeat.

fields.name: loss_of_support_state
fields.meaning: Modeled consequences of support interruption, separately from an electrical trip.

fields.name: independent_supervisor_ack
fields.meaning: Requested output action versus observed acknowledgment distinguished.

contracts.initial_mode_arbitration: MOTOR_PRACTICE and SBP_SUPPORT mutually exclusive. Observe-only and archive services may coexist within explicit budgets; service/energy-transfer coexistence requires qualification.
contracts.motor_link_loss: No new remote goal or calibration changes. A committed local plan may continue until its0.25s lease expires, only while local observations, route, monitor and energy health remain qualified. Expired or unsupported plans are rejected.
contracts.pressure_link_loss: If the UI link is lost but an independent authenticated pressure path remains fresh, the committed local policy may continue only within its3s lease. If the lost link also carries pressure, the measurement-freshness gate applies. Continued sensor service is not assumed.
contracts.pressure_stale_rule: Block new adaptation and enter the declared digital fallback variant. Finite hold, ramp/stop and loss-of-support consequences must be tested separately; none is labelled universally safe.
contracts.active_pressure_admission: Requires a selected fallback_id, defined target/risk protocol, sensor accuracy and age bound, authority range, and source/monitor limits. Stage2 does not supply clinical qualification.
contracts.phase_interruption_rule: For a nonelectrical observation fault, completion of the committed balancing phase is allowed only while clock, power, route and delivery monitor are healthy and the policy permits it. Electrical, clock or power faults may interrupt the phase; record residual uncertainty and do not supply an automatic corrective pulse.
contracts.reset_rule: Start a new session in observe mode. No silent resume; reboot does not clear uncertain interrupted charge.

contracts.name: Assistance-free learning and transfer assessment

fields.name: study_condition
fields.meaning: Neural-plus-external versus external-only, crossed with expert-informed versus learner-only; include an expert external-trajectory-only comparator.

fields.name: practice_exposure
fields.meaning: Equal-budget learner practice and calibration; report expert training cost separately.

fields.name: assistance_state
fields.meaning: ON, OFF_RETENTION or OFF_TRANSFER; independent monitoring confirms that output is off during probes.

fields.name: surrogate_learning_family
fields.meaning: FAVORABLE,ZERO,HARMFUL_OR_DEPENDENT,NO_AUTHORITY; preregistered artificial assumptions.

fields.name: heldout_context_and_subject_ids
fields.meaning: No overlapping-window subject/session leakage.

fields.name: outcomes
fields.meaning: Contact timing, spatial/coordination error, retention, transfer, effort and sensory cost; record threshold censoring.

invariants: Controller cannot read internal learner skill or adaptation state.
Temporary assistance and retained learning are reported separately.
Positive efficacy or a1.5x/2x learning multiplier is not required.
Record null and negative comparisons; separate Monte Carlo confidence from structural model uncertainty.
Biological interpretation depends on future source evidence; additional synthetic trials do not validate the assumptions.
contracts.completion_scope: Later model verification may show no added spinal or expert information. That is a valid result,not a failed software deliverable.

unresolved_qualification: Causal decoding/feature information age and subject/session generalization.
Clinical external pressure accuracy,timestamp semantics and actual sensor/link delay.
Calibrated biological response onset,release,selectivity,plasticity and off-target costs.
Independent electrical protection and monitor detection timing.
Artifact recovery perchannel and simultaneous delivery route independence.
Function-specific physiological fallback and real lost-support risk.
MCU worst-case schedule,WCET evidence and sensor/radio transport benchmarks.
